item.title: Sen. Bill Cassidy saying RFK Jr. is "covering a series of failures"
item.description: Sen. Bill Cassidy, who is on the Senate health committee, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is "covering for a series of failures" after the health secretary said the Senate will not have leverage over him now that Democrats are taking over and Stephen Miller is the new White House chief of staff.

item.title: Rep. Moolenaar says it's "outrageous" to not see Jensen Huang affair as national security risk
item.description: Rep. John Moolenaar, who chairs the select committee on the Chinese Communist Party, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy compromised national security. "These are vital technologies that our military depend upon, our commercial entities depend upon, and for Nvidia and for Jensen Huang, not to view that as a national security risk is outrageous," Moolenaar said.

item.title: UPS plane, passenger jet collide on Miami airport taxiway
item.description: A UPS cargo plane and a Copa Airlines jet carrying 172 people collided while taxiing at Miami International Airport, leaving two passengers with minor injuries.

item.description: ICE announced last week that it deported just over 483,000 people in the 2026 fiscal year, a record in immigration enforcement history. The announcement comes as immigration hardliner Stephen Miller has been elevated to White House chief of staff.

item.title: Rep. Himes says Democrats are worried as Trump, Lutnick are "buddy buddies" with Jensen Huang
item.description: Rep. Jim Himes, the ranking member of the House Intelligence Committee, alleged on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that President Trump and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick were "buddy buddies" with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Meanwhile, Himes said it's unclear if there's an investigation into Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
